description.narrative: ltpgtBased on the information provided in the documents SC 2024 Activities Handbook_v1_2 and Winterisation Recommendations 2024-2025 from the SNFI cluster, needs assessment, communication with beneficiaries, community leaders who are aware of the problems of residents living in the areas bordering the front line, it was decided to organise assistance to vulnerable populations in preparation for the winter of 2024-2025. The experience and needs identified during the previous winter were also taken into account.ltbrgtThe general idea of the project is to help various vulnerable categories in the most convenient way for them, covering the most common needs. According to the terms of the Call for Proposal, several areas of activity were identified.ltbrgtFirstly, people living in rural areas who need to heat their homes in winter will be provided with fuel briquettes, in the form of in-kind or cash assistance. Vulnerable families will be selected and briquettes will be provided, through direct delivery to their homes or through cash transfer, in the amount recommended by the SNFI cluster, which will help to significantly reduce the burden on the family budget of these families and ensure preparation for the heating season. ltbrgtSecondly, for those beneficiaries living in the city who will face a significant increase in utility bills during the winter period, assistance will be organised to compensate for the cost of utility bills. ltbrgtThroughout the duration of the project, coordination with the SNFI cluster will be ensured on priority areas to avoid duplication, as well as interaction on deduplication of assistance. The amount of compensation for utility bills for heating and the cost of solid fuel will be calculated according to the documents from the cluster. ltbrgtThe experience gained by Posmishka UA in implementing activities in preparation for the winter of 2023-2024 allows us to state that our team is ready to work in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk, Dnipro and Kharkiv regions in accordance with the recommendation of the SNFI cluster. ltbrgtlt/pgt
